description: Read Denmark's official statistics from Statistics Denmark (Danmarks Statistik): the consumer price index and inflation, unemployment, population by municipality, GDP and about 2,300 more StatBank tables on prices, labour, housing, business and the economy. Browse subjects, search tables or list those updated since a day, see what a table holds, and get its figures as clean rows with labels and units, in English or Danish. A trigger starts a workflow when a table is updated. No account or API key required.
